text: Foundation F1-F5 (foundation.md D1-D6) built in this epic first: the any-mcp orchestrator plugin, the wrapper notes inbox and main-agent gate, ClusterSpec max_replicas and static with render gating and pins, the agent API with its port, token and pod-IP identity, and migration 0003.

Hive mode: dispatcher leadership authority with epoch fencing, leader-only routing, the activity feed and hive-state notes, advisory file locks, leader in views, stream and UI, the bench arm and API-only kind e2e.
Releases across repos are explicit tasks: any-mcp v0.2.0 tag, claude-code-wrapper 0.2.0 image and tag, the orchestrator pins, the agents-helmfile bump, apply and smoke.

One shared orchestrator any-mcp plugin carries every agent-to-orchestrator tool (leadership, file locks, scale, init-script edit) with a per-cluster scoped credential in the pod; built once here, the other epics add tools to it.
Headless parity: every UI capability has a documented public API and an API-only e2e test.
The leader is the only agent that receives untargeted messages; an explicit target still wins.
The first ready agent leads when a hive starts, at epoch 1.
